mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP2D6 and CYP3A4) which metabolize sumatriptan, potentially increasing sumatriptan plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including coronary vasospasm.
action: Monitor patients closely for sumatriptan adverse effects (chest pain, palpitations, hypertension); consider dose reduction or alternative triptan; ensure adequate washout if switching medications.
